introduction.en: Counterforce Health combines denial-letter drafting with experimental telephone follow-up.
introduction.zh: Counterforce Health 将拒赔申诉信起草与试验中的电话跟进结合。

method.en: Counterforce Health used service-code references, external-review records and insurer-litigation materials. Users selected a common denial or supplied policies, medical records and the rejection letter.
method.zh: Counterforce Health使用服务编码、外部审查记录及保险诉讼材料；用户选择常见拒赔问题，或提供保单、病历与拒赔信。

method.en: The system drafted a referenced appeal in under a minute according to the source. A voice agent called Maxwell handled follow-up calls and was still being tested.
method.zh: 源站称系统不到一分钟可起草带依据的申诉信；Maxwell语音agent负责后续电话，当时仍在测试。

outcome.en: The account says thousands had used the letter tool since a January beta, including three small clinics using it regularly; appeal win rates were not disclosed.
outcome.zh: 叙述称自1月测试版以来已有数千人使用信件工具，三家小诊所经常使用，但未披露申诉成功率。

notes.en: Users were not charged. CareYaya’s impact fund reportedly covered a few cents per letter and $1.50 per ten minutes of calls; these costs do not establish a commercial margin or voice reliability.
notes.zh: 用户不收费；据述CareYaya影响力基金承担每封信数美分、每十分钟电话1.50美元，不能据此认定商业利润或语音可靠性。
